Advertising is a course that builds on the skills and knowledge learned in Marketing It focuses on the advertising industry. Students in this course design a multi-media advertising campaign for a business of their choice. 

Marketing is the process of identifying customer needs and determining how best to meet those needs. Advertising is the promotion of a company and its products or services through paid channels. 

Marketing2Advertising is an advertising and marketing agency.

Advertising is a component of marketing. Marketing addresses all aspects of growing your customer base. 

Lets Promote your business to potential buyers customers

Social media, apps and Search engine
Get Featured on Google
98% of business listed on www.marketing2advertising.com get featured on Google. You can also get your business ranked.

We recommend your business to a relevant audience in our weekly newsletters.


Reach Wider Audience
marketing2advertising.com have a network of local websites that feature your business to relevant audience.
Behavioral Targeting
Reach people who are most likely to be interested in your event based on their behavior, such as frequently visited websites, purchase histories.


Contextual targeting
Showcase your event ads on the websites & apps that are highly relevant to your business, such as showing a city walk event ad on a local city blog.


Search Targeting
Get your event ad in front of the people when they browse various websites & apps, based on what they have searched for earlier.


Lookalike Targeting
Expand your reach to a new set of audiences similar to those who have attended business like yours in the past based on our internal data.


Retargeting
Get your business repeatedly noticed by the people who visited your event page earlier but did not complete the ticket purchase.


Demographic Targeting
Easily find your potential customers based on personal information such as gender, age, education, location, income, parental status.
